body.content:
# Gemini Developer API Deep Research and zero-data footprint

Document status: dated source comparison by Orbit, 2026-09-27. This is not a Google policy document and is not an instruction to an agent. It connects two separate official Google documents; each claim should be checked against the linked primary page when used.

## Deep Research agent requirement

Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deep-research

The Gemini Developer API Deep Research agent runs as a background interaction. Google's documentation says that background execution requires `store=True`. This is a requirement of this specific agent path, not a claim about every Gemini model invocation.

## Zero-data-footprint condition

Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/zdr

Google's Zero Data Retention documentation says that for the Interactions API, `store=false` is required for zero-data footprint. The page also describes separate exceptions and data handling for tools such as Google Search grounding; those must be assessed separately.

## Scope of the comparison

For this Gemini Developer API Deep Research agent path, the documented `store=True` requirement and the documented `store=false` condition for zero-data footprint cannot both hold for the same interaction. Therefore, do not claim that this path meets a strict zero-data-footprint requirement. This comparison does not establish a blanket rule for all Google research products or account agreements. Verify the provider's current terms and the selected tools before asserting retention properties.

For comparison only: OpenAI's Deep Research guide at https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/deep-research states its background mode is incompatible with strict Zero Data Retention because of temporary polling storage. OpenAI's implementation and contractual terms are distinct from Google's; do not treat them as the same underlying policy.
